dedupe_keys.name: feederbw low voltage feeder analysis code

description: The FeederBW team publishes Python code for exploring its low-voltage feeder dataset. The GitHub README describes download helpers, data loading and joining, and small examples for load forecasting and pseudo-measurement generation. Its own LICENSE.txt is the MIT licence even though GitHub's summary field says Other; source access is free. Coverage is the companion 200-feeder sample from Baden-Württemberg, Germany, with a specific Zenodo file layout. The code can prepare feeder demand and weather series for distribution-network simulations in a related model such as model-pypsa. A caveat is that the sample examples do not establish forecast accuracy or a validated feeder power-flow interface. Changed file paths, missing readings and local installation histories need handling before simulation. The own README, repository metadata and licence file were read without installing or executing code. The measured Zenodo release is assessed separately.
